title: Developing Precision Nitrogen Fertilization Research, Achmad Tijani Secures Indofood Riset Nugraha Funding 2026–2027
excerpt: Yogyakarta, 28 September 2026: Achmad Tijani, a student in the Agricultural Engineering Study Program class of 2023 at FTP UGM and a member of the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) UGM 2026, has been selected as a recipient of research funding support in the Indofood Riset Nugraha (IRN) program for the period 2026–2027. body:
**Yogyakarta, 28 September 2026:** Achmad Tijani, a student in the Agricultural Engineering Study Program class of 2023 at FTP UGM and a member of the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) UGM 2026, has been selected as a recipient of research funding support in the Indofood Riset Nugraha (IRN) program for the period 2026–2027. This achievement was obtained through a research proposal titled "Development of a Response Based Management Zone Model Based on Physical and Chemical Soil Characteristics for Precision Nitrogen Fertilization in Superior Local Rice Seed Varieties".

According to the IRN Committee announcement, Achmad Tijani is one of 83 participants from various higher education institutions throughout Indonesia listed in the participant roster of the IRN 2026–2027 program. The funding support is intended to assist the implementation of undergraduate student research as part of the completion of final assignments or theses. Complete information regarding the list of research funding recipients for the IRN period 2026–2027 is available through the [IRN 2026–2027 Participant Announcement](https://www.indofoodrisetnugraha.com/irn/uploads/file/newsevents/2026/PENGUMUMAN_PESERTA_IRN_2026-2027.pdf) on the official Indofood Riset Nugraha website.

The research proposed by Achmad Tijani focuses on the development of a response based management zone model while taking into account the physical and chemical characteristics of soil. This model is directed to support precision nitrogen fertilization in superior local rice seed varieties.

![IMAGE_0]

Responding to this success, Achmad Tijani expressed his happiness, emotion, and gratitude for the opportunity he has received. For him, this funding support is one of the meaningful moments after going through a research proposal submission process with effort, prayer, and hope.

> "Alhamdulillah, it feels like a mix of happiness, emotion, gratitude, and slight disbelief. There is a sense of pride, but also a great sense of responsibility to carry out this mandate as well as possible," Achmad said.

He hopes that this opportunity will be an initial step to continue learning, developing, and producing useful research. Achmad Tijani also expressed his gratitude to all parties who have provided support and prayers during the process he has gone through.

> "May this be a first step to continue learning, growing, and producing research that is beneficial. Thank you to everyone who has supported and prayed for me. May the process ahead be blessed with smoothness," he said.

IRN is one of the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programs of PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk that was launched in 2006. The program provides research funding assistance to undergraduate students at both public and private higher education institutions to support the completion of final assignments or theses. In addition to providing funding support, IRN aims to foster students' interest and ability to conduct quality scientific research. The support also includes training and guidance on research methodology for prospective and current IRN participants.

The IRN proposal selection includes administrative evaluation and substantive evaluation. Administrative evaluation is conducted to verify completeness and conformance to requirements, while substantive evaluation is performed by a panel of experts to assess the quality and feasibility of the research, including objectives, benefits, potential findings, and the proposed methodology.

Through this program, Indofood builds a space for collaboration with higher education institutions while encouraging the involvement of young researchers from various disciplines in the advancement of food research. The program also supports efforts to strengthen national food security through the utilization of potential and diversification of food based on local commodities.

Achmad Tijani's success in obtaining IRN 2026–2027 support provides an opportunity to develop research on precision nitrogen fertilization. This research is expected to yield a scientific basis for fertilization management that is more suited to soil characteristics and contribute to the development of efficient and sustainable agriculture.

##### **Linkage to the SDGs**

-   **SDG 2 – Zero Hunger**, through research directed to support food production management and the development of potential in local rice.
-   **SDG 4 – Quality Education**, through support for final assignment research and strengthening students' capacity in scientific research.
-   **SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure**, through the development of a precision agriculture model based on physical and chemical soil characteristics.
-   **SDG 12 – Responsible Consumption and Production**, through the development of a fertilization approach directed at the efficient use of nitrogen fertilizer.
-   **SDG 17 – Partnerships to Achieve the Goals**, through support from industry to student research at higher education institutions.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, 28 September 2026:** Achmad Tijani, mahasiswa Program Studi Teknik Pertanian angkatan 2023 FTP UGM, sekaligus anggota Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) UGM 2026, berhasil lolos sebagai peserta penerima bantuan dana penelitian dalam program Indofood Riset Nugraha (IRN) periode 2026–2027. Capaian tersebut diperoleh melalui usulan penelitian berjudul “Pengembangan Model _Response Based Management Zone_ Berbasis Karakteristik Fisik dan Kimia Tanah untuk Pemupukan Nitrogen Presisi pada Benih Padi Lokal Varietas Unggul”.

Berdasarkan pengumuman Panitia IRN, Achmad Tijani merupakan salah satu dari 83 peserta dari berbagai perguruan tinggi di Indonesia yang tercantum dalam daftar peserta program IRN 2026–2027. Dukungan pendanaan tersebut ditujukan untuk membantu pelaksanaan penelitian mahasiswa strata satu dalam rangka penyelesaian tugas akhir atau skripsi. Informasi selengkapnya mengenai daftar peserta penerima bantuan dana penelitian IRN periode 2026–2027 dapat diakses melalui [pengumuman peserta IRN 2026–2027](https://www.indofoodrisetnugraha.com/irn/uploads/file/newsevents/2026/PENGUMUMAN_PESERTA_IRN_2026-2027.pdf) di situs resmi Indofood Riset Nugraha.

Penelitian yang diusulkan Achmad Tijani berfokus pada pengembangan model zona pengelolaan berbasis respons atau _response based management zone_ dengan mempertimbangkan karakteristik fisik dan kimia tanah. Model tersebut diarahkan untuk mendukung pemupukan nitrogen secara presisi pada benih padi lokal varietas unggul.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1186-1-image-30-1030x461.webp)

Menanggapi keberhasilan tersebut, Achmad Tijani mengungkapkan rasa bahagia, haru, dan syukur atas kesempatan yang diperolehnya. Baginya, dukungan pendanaan ini menjadi salah satu momen berarti setelah melalui proses pengajuan penelitian dengan usaha, doa, dan harapan.

> “Alhamdulillah, rasanya campur aduk antara bahagia, terharu, bersyukur, dan sedikit tidak percaya. Ada rasa bangga, tetapi juga tanggung jawab besar untuk menjalankan amanah ini dengan sebaik-baiknya,” ungkap Achmad.

Ia berharap kesempatan tersebut menjadi langkah awal untuk terus belajar, berkembang, dan menghasilkan penelitian yang bermanfaat. Achmad Tijani juga menyampaikan terima kasih kepada semua pihak yang telah memberikan dukungan dan doa selama proses yang dilaluinya.

> “Semoga ini menjadi langkah awal untuk terus belajar, berkembang, dan menghasilkan penelitian yang bermanfaat. Terima kasih untuk semua yang telah mendukung dan mendoakan. Semoga proses kedepannya diberikan kelancaran,” tuturnya.

IRN merupakan salah satu program _Corporate Social Responsibility_ (CSR) PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk yang mulai digulirkan pada 2006. Program ini memberikan bantuan dana penelitian kepada mahasiswa S-1 di perguruan tinggi negeri maupun swasta untuk mendukung penyelesaian tugas akhir atau skripsi. Selain memberikan dukungan pendanaan, IRN bertujuan menumbuhkan minat dan kemampuan mahasiswa dalam melaksanakan penelitian ilmiah yang berkualitas. Dukungan tersebut juga mencakup pelatihan dan pembimbingan metodologi penelitian bagi calon peserta maupun peserta IRN.

Seleksi proposal IRN mencakup evaluasi administratif dan evaluasi substansi. Evaluasi administratif dilakukan untuk memeriksa kelengkapan serta kesesuaian persyaratan, sedangkan evaluasi substansi dilakukan oleh tim panelis untuk menilai kualitas dan kelayakan penelitian, termasuk tujuan, manfaat, potensi temuan, serta metodologi yang diusulkan.

Melalui program ini, Indofood membangun ruang kolaborasi dengan perguruan tinggi sekaligus mendorong keterlibatan peneliti muda dari berbagai disiplin ilmu dalam pengembangan riset pangan. Program tersebut juga mendukung upaya penguatan ketahanan pangan nasional melalui pemanfaatan potensi dan diversifikasi pangan berbasis komoditas lokal.

Keberhasilan Achmad Tijani memperoleh dukungan IRN 2026–2027 menjadi kesempatan untuk mengembangkan penelitian pemupukan nitrogen presisi. Penelitian ini diharapkan dapat menghasilkan dasar ilmiah bagi pengelolaan pemupukan yang lebih sesuai dengan karakteristik tanah serta berkontribusi pada pengembangan pertanian yang efisien dan berkelanjutan.

##### **Keterkaitan dengan SDGs**

-   **SDG 2 – Tanpa Kelaparan**, melalui penelitian yang diarahkan untuk mendukung pengelolaan produksi pangan dan pengembangan potensi padi lokal.
-   **SDG 4 – Pendidikan Berkualitas**, melalui dukungan penelitian tugas akhir serta penguatan kapasitas mahasiswa dalam penelitian ilmiah.
-   **SDG 9 – Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur**, melalui pengembangan model pertanian presisi berbasis karakteristik fisik dan kimia tanah.
-   **SDG 12 – Konsumsi dan Produksi yang Bertanggung Jawab**, melalui pengembangan pendekatan pemupukan yang diarahkan pada efisiensi penggunaan pupuk nitrogen.
-   **SDG 17 – Kemitraan untuk Mencapai Tujuan**, melalui dukungan dunia industri terhadap penelitian mahasiswa di perguruan tinggi.
